author: Mike Okay
description:
I travelled along Papua New Guinea's isolated coastline, a place where the jungle still hides relics from World War II. During the war, more than 100,000 Japanese soldiers were stationed in Papua New Guinea, and some of the fiercest fighting of the Pacific campaign took place along this very coast.
